selection.method: Purposive challenge cohort chosen using historical issues and evidence types; no random-sample accuracy inference.
selection.historical_labels: Selection context only; never a gold standard or a new rating.
selection.replacement_policy: No case replacement after new ratings. A changed cohort, evidence package or threshold requires a separately identified round retaining the original.

experimental_literature.rationale: The three structural cases assert an observation link without a result, an identity match, and a taxon/type-strain match. Their identity, claim, relation, nodes and source fidelity still require assessment with appropriate authority evidence. All ten retain a literature category. A reviewer challenging applicability records a protocol deviation; the denominator is not silently changed.

independence.design: Separate fresh review sessions, same pinned evidence package, no access to the other new rating matrix before both are frozen. Record historical-label exposure and model identity; same-model sessions are not independent expert validation.
independence.adjudication: Preserve both initial matrices and every disagreement. A separate evidence-based disposition follows raw agreement calculation. Unresolved disagreement over any resolved claim or modeling judgment blocks passage.
independence.evidence_freeze: Before either reviewer starts, pin source packets, full evidence inputs, authority versions, proof adapters and instructions in an immutable round manifest. This preparation protocol is not that evidence freeze.

critical_overclaims.denominator: Report each class separately over all corresponding labels emitted by both reviewers before reconciliation; zero emitted labels means untested, never zero error proved. Also audit final labels.

evidence_replay.scope: Every cited input, quote, DOI or alternate publication identity, authority version, packet and saved canonical review pair; no unverifiable item omitted from denominator.

interpretation.threshold_basis: Conservative operational design choices fixed before scoring, not a statistical guarantee or externally validated scientific standard.
interpretation.failure_policy: Improve evidence or rubric and register a new round; retain failed results. Do not lower thresholds after observing ratings.
interpretation.passing_scope: Passing all criteria permits deeper review of the remaining retained 90 only. It does not admit graph assertions or expand to the other 9900.
interpretation.expansion_requirements: All retained-100 accounting, evidence/modeling gates and at least one independently verified real correction against regenerated candidate bytes remain mandatory.
interpretation.resolution_reporting: Publish each resolution numerator/denominator, all ten literature categories, exact literature support/refutation/conflict over the seven applicable cases, six initial category confusion tables, all disagreements and unresolved blockers. Do not combine axes into a truth score.

preparation_constraints.authenticated_general_helper: Deferred pending separately authorized merge of PR102; local retained-evidence preparation is permitted.
